title: Chapter 1467
text:
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios

Establishment of the Supers Holy Land

Somewhere in the explored universe, the Avengers' fleet was slowly moving.

Inside the cabin, Pangon and the others were surrounding the virtual screen, watching the news of the three Universal Civilizations' victory.

Looking at the joyous looks of the countless galactic races on the screen, the Beyond Grade As present had complicated expressions.

"Humph, the three Universal Civilizations have become the winners, and the galactic society has escaped a calamity. Pangon, are you satisfied now?"

A Beyond Grade A stood with his arms crossed and said with dissatisfaction.

Pangon was expressionless. "There's nothing to be happy about."

"Is that so? But why do I feel like you don't mean what you say? Don't forget what our goal is! To be honest, if you've given up on revenge, you should disband as soon as possible, "another person said coldly.

These people had been planning their revenge against the three Universal Civilizations. The galactic society was celebrating their victory, so of course, they could not be happy. They only felt annoyed.

Facing Pangon, who was' not firm enough ', they naturally did not have a good expression.

Pangon was unmoved and said calmly, "If you have time to talk nonsense, you might as well think about your next move."

"You still have the face to say that? This war was clearly a good opportunity for revenge. If not for you insisting that we not use this as a pretext, we would have long …"

"Black Star would have killed us long ago." Pangon interrupted him and slowly said, "From the current results, the conclusion is that even if we cause trouble, we won't be able to change the outcome of the three Universal Civilizations winning. This is because the key factors that decide the war will not be affected by us at all … Therefore, if we take advantage of the war, we will be wiped out. You all have to be glad that I saved our lives."

Hearing this, everyone was furious. Every time they talked about this topic, Pangon would use similar reasons to persuade them, and the key was that it was not easy to refute.

At this moment, Pangon changed the topic and said, "Also, don't you think that this new situation of internal conflicts is a good environment for our development? The reason why I don't agree with causing trouble in the war is because I saw this. If the three Universal Civilizations lost, we wouldn't have to do anything. Now that they've won, they will form a new balance with the Beyond Grade A Association and the Supercluster Alliance after the war, and we will have room to maneuver …

Therefore, what I've always emphasized is that we have to be forward-looking and foresee the changes in the future. We can't just look for a moment. "

Pangon's tone Pangon

Everyone had strange expressions on their faces.

'This sentence sounds right, but it doesn't sound right coming from the mouth of a martial artist …'

After taking one last look at the galactic refugees in the news, Pangon turned around and left the room.

When he turned around, the corners of his mouth faintly curled up a little, but then it disappeared. He said indifferently, "That's right.

"Don't look anymore. Let's go. Their joy has nothing to do with us."

…

The 'migration' of the refugees from the various Star Fields was in full swing. However, one day, an explosive piece of news once again caused a huge shock in the galactic society.

On this day, the Beyond Grade A Association officially announced the establishment of a civilization regime called the 'Supers Holy Land'. The civil association organization was upgraded to the Civilization Elders Association. All the Beyond Grade As of the association were members of the Elders Association, and a portion of them, represented by Black Star, were the main decision-makers.

The nature of the civilization was one of the more common immigrant countries in the galactic society. They expressed that they would openly accept all the Supers with good credit as citizens of the Supers Holy Land, regardless of race. The banner was' building a resplendent country that belonged to the Supers'.

The Beyond Grade As were the leaders of the Super class to begin with. They were like wind vanes, enough to guide a portion of people to join. Furthermore, Black Star was the only Transcendent at the moment, so the attraction to the Supers was even greater.

Of course, there were more substantial benefits. As long as one became a citizen of the Supers Holy Land, they could obtain Super knowledge of the various major systems from the official channels and apply for customized training programs to help them increase their Grade. In addition, official citizens could also choose to enjoy the protection of the Underworld. If they unfortunately died or died of old age, they could choose to continue living as Heroic Spirits. If they advanced to the Beyond Grade A realm, they would directly enter the Elders Association and enjoy the protection of the Sanctum Revival for free.

Other than that, there were also various detailed rules and regulations, civil rights, and other provisions. They were jointly formulated by the professionals of the various Beyond Grade A organizations. They referred to the systems of many galactic civilizations and made adaptable changes.

The location of the Supers Holy Land was in the Flickering World, and almost half of its territory was taken away. There were also some Star Clusters that had not been fully explored, located at the outermost region of the explored universe. However, the territory was not limited to this. The desolate universe belt outside the border of the Flickering World was also included in the territory of the Supers Holy Land.

This had to be mentioned about the 'regurgitation' mechanism of the World Tree, which could transform countless planets. The desolate areas could also be transformed into prosperous Star Fields. Therefore, the Supers Holy Land had obtained a territory that could continuously expand outward without any restrictions.

The first batch of citizens were the races or civilizations under the jurisdiction of the various Beyond Grade As. They were migrating over, and the members of the various Beyond Grade A organizations were also close to the water. As long as they were willing, they could obtain the citizenship of the Supers Holy Land. If they were unwilling, they would not force it. These people built the framework of the Supers Holy Land.

This was clearly taking advantage of the entire universe. Any civilization would face the risk of losing Supers. However, the three Universal Civilizations did not stand out to object. Instead, they sent a congratulatory message to congratulate the establishment of the Supers Holy Land in the name of the Star Ocean Civilization General Court. At the same time, they accepted the Supers Holy Land as a new member of the Civilization Conference.

The two sides had already reached an agreement. The Beyond Grade A Association would obtain the status of a civilization's regime after the war. The three Universal Civilizations had already contacted Han Xiao during this period of time. Even if they were unwilling, they had no choice but to fulfill the agreement.

The smooth migration of a small half of the Flickering World and many Beyond Grade A races was all because of Han Xiao. The three Universal Civilizations finally relented.

…

Before the joy of victory in the war faded, the galactic residents had a new topic. The birth of the Supers Holy Land caused a heated discussion in the entire galactic society.

Although many galactic residents had guessed that the Beyond Grade A Association would make a big move after the war, due to the lack of information, no one had expected the Beyond Grade A Association to make a move so quickly and with such a huge commotion.

Ordinary people were only shocked and discussing, but the entire Super class was in an uproar!

The Supers Holy Land was far more attractive to the Super class than any civilization. Just the two benefits of the Underworld and the Sanctum Revival were enough to move countless people. In addition, there was free public knowledge, free training, and a series of other benefits.

After enjoying the taste of extraordinary strength, it was basically impossible for them to be satisfied with the current situation. Most Supers had the ambition to advance further. The treatment of the Supers Holy Land was enviable, and they did not have to bear as many obligations as joining a Beyond Grade A organization.

Although the Supers had privileges in the galactic society, they also had all kinds of concerns. Under the tacit understanding of the advanced civilizations, many middle and low-level Supers had to sell their lives in exchange for various resources and knowledge. This was one of the methods the advanced civilizations used to maintain the balance, lest the Supers become an unstable factor in society.

Now that the Supers Holy Land had shouted the slogan of 'establishing the holy land of Supers', it caused a thousand waves. Batches of Supers no longer hesitated and eagerly joined.

Before the World Tree War, they might have been afraid of the authority of the three Universal Civilizations, afraid that they would be cut off from the galactic society. Just like how the three Universal Civilizations suppressed the Beyond Grade A Association back then, many people did not dare to join the Beyond Grade A organization … Now that the political status of the Supers Holy Land was recognized, Black Star was no longer the ordinary Beyond Grade A of the past.

Everyone could see that the Supers Holy Land and the three Universal Civilizations had reached the same level, and it was impossible for them to repeat the same mistake. Therefore, many Supers no longer had any worries … Even if the galactic society banned them, they could just live in the Supers Holy Land in the future. What was there to be afraid of?

…

At the border of the Flickering World.

Han Xiao floated in the desolate universe belt, his entire body burning with the power of the World Tree. Facing the pitch-black space, he waved his hands rhythmically as if he was leading an orchestra to play a symphony.

Under his command, roots tore through space and slowly took root. At the same time, the ends of the roots seemed to be spitting bubbles, sprinkling planets in this galaxy, expanding the territory of the Supers Holy Land.

Behind him, a group of Beyond Grade As were watching the scene of the planets moving with shock.

No matter how many times they saw this scene, everyone was shocked and in awe.

After a while, Han Xiao finally finished modifying this area. He retracted the power of the World Tree, turned around, and flew to everyone.

"Maintain such a large territory for now. It should be enough."

"As long as you're happy …"

Everyone had mixed feelings and did not know what to say.

Han Xiao turned to look at Aurora and asked, "What does the galactic society think of the Supers Holy Land now?"

"About 120 billion Supers have already applied to become citizens of the Supers Holy Land, and this number is still rising rapidly," Aurora said.

"It's a little small, but it's just the beginning. Many people are still hesitating. When we completely stabilize, the population will skyrocket."

Han Xiao nodded casually.

During this period of time, he had been running around and talking to the leaders of various organizations. He reached a consensus and finally established the Supers Holy Land.

Establishing a civilization was very complicated, and all kinds of structures needed to be perfected. However, Han Xiao only needed to control the general direction and simple diplomacy. The details were filled in by the professional subordinates of the various Beyond Grade A organizations.

Because it was the general trend, even the three Universal Civilizations did not try to trip him up. The establishment of the Supers Holy Land was smoother than Han Xiao had expected.

From now on, the Beyond Grade As were officially unified. In the future, they could all carry the banner of the Supers Holy Land and move around in the universe. The structure of the galactic society had truly become a tripartite structure. Han Xiao asked himself if he had fulfilled his promise to the Beyond Grade A Association.

Many Beyond Grade As became the upper echelons of the Elders Association of the Supers Holy Land. Among them, Aurora was promoted by Han Xiao to be his deputy, replacing Kasuyi's position. This personnel change received everyone's approval … In the entire Beyond Grade A group, only Aurora could convince the masses.

This was also Kasuyi's own intention. He had originally planned to explore the unknown universe after the war, and Han Xiao had also changed his position according to his request.

Because Oathkeeper had also teamed up with Kasuyi, the Holy Covenant also had an empty position. Therefore, Han Xiao let Beiger become the acting leader of the Holy Covenant and handed over the job to Oathkeeper.

Beiger, on the other hand, did not mind being a mascot-like acting leader. However, Han Xiao did not care much about the Holy Covenant anymore.

After obtaining the World Tree that could convert resources, he no longer needed the Holy Covenant organization to help him collect the Sanctum keys. The main reason was to fulfill his previous promise and leave a place for the Beyond Grade As who were willing to retire.

Han Xiao turned around and looked at Psyker, who was hiding in the crowd. He raised his chin and said,

He raised his chin and said, "The one with seven eyes, haven't you always wanted to relocate your race? Move your Star Pupil civilization to the Supers Holy Land. No one will suppress you here."

"Really? I don't believe it. "

Sisko expressed his strong doubts.

Even today, his Black Star PTSD had not been cured. He kept feeling that Han Xiao was up to no good.

Han Xiao secretly rolled his eyes and did not want to talk to him.

At this moment, Hilbert led a group of direct revivors out of the crowd with a smile on his face.

"Black Star, I wonder if the Supers Holy Land welcomes us?"

Hilbert had always had the idea of leaving the three Universal Civilizations and joining the Beyond Grade A Association. Now that the war was over and the Beyond Grade As had established a civilization, he had finally made up his mind. He brought some direct revivors who also felt that they did not owe the three Universal Civilizations to join the alliance. Naturally, he wanted the unlimited Sanctum Revival guarantee.

Seeing this, Han Xiao smiled.

"The three Universal Civilizations are even angrier now. If you guys make such a choice, it might invalidate the 'retirement benefits' that you guys exchanged your lives for. Are you sure?"

"It doesn't matter. We've all died for the three Universal Civilizations. We don't owe them anything anymore. It's time to live for ourselves." Hilbert smiled.

"In that case, the Supers Holy Land welcomes everyone."

Han Xiao nodded and sighed.

According to this trend, the Supers Holy Land might really be able to capture all the individual powers in the universe in one fell swoop in the future.

At that time, the Supers Holy Land would become a place that all Supers yearned for. Almost all the naturally awakened civilian Supers would gather, and the other civilizations would only have the Supers nurtured by their direct descendants … Hmm, from another perspective, this could also be considered to have increased the security of the galactic society, helping the various civilizations to consolidate their rule, and creating a more stable living environment for the galactic residents …

"Sigh, I'm indeed still concerned about peace. The three Universal Civilizations don't understand me."

Han Xiao shook his head and sighed, not embarrassed at all.

Thank you for the 20000 reward from Ah Jin's harem!

(End of Chapter)
